panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Whether the exporter can reach each server. Unknown means the exporter cannot be scraped.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((label_replace((((redis_up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) == 1))) or on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) * 0 - 1)), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), "node", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "node", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: Memory used / maxmemory
panels.description: Server memory relative to configured maxmemory. Orange at 80%; red at 95%. No maxmemory means no server memory limit is configured.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((label_replace(((((100 * redis_memory_used_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} / (redis_memory_max_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} > 0)) or (redis_memory_max_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} * 0 - 2 and redis_memory_max_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} == 0)) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) == 1) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (redis_up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} == 1))) or on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) * 0 - 1)), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), "node", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "node", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: Successful key lookups in the recent rate window. No lookups means the cache is idle. This is key reuse, not the scanner client-pool hit rate.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((label_replace(((((100 * rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) / ((rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(redis_keyspace_misses_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) or ((rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(redis_keyspace_misses_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0 - 2 and (rate(redis_keyspace_hits_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(redis_keyspace_misses_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) == 0)) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) == 1) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (redis_up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} == 1))) or on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) * 0 - 1)), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), "node", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "node", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.title: Evictions (selected range)
panels.description: Keys removed to enforce maxmemory during the selected range. Eviction is expected in a bounded cache; rising evictions with slow scans can mean frequent re-analysis.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((label_replace((((increase(redis_evicted_keys_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}[$__range])) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) == 1) and on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (redis_up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"} == 1))) or on (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (max by (cluster,namespace,service,instance,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",service!="",service=~"${redis_service:regex}"}) * 0 - 1)), "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), "node", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "node", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.description: Used memory, resident process memory, and configured maxmemory. A zero maxmemory setting is omitted; container limits are separate.
panels.title: Memory and limit

panels.description: Successful and missing key lookups per minute. Misses require Trivy to compute or fetch analysis again when this server is its analysis cache.
panels.title: Cache lookups

panels.description: Evicted keys are removed for memory pressure; expired keys reached their TTL. These are different causes of cache misses.
panels.title: Evictions and expiry

panels.description: Memory used by stored data and server bookkeeping, per server.
panels.title: Memory breakdown

panels.description: Total keys and keys with an expiry in each non-empty logical Redis database. A logical database number does not isolate memory limits.
panels.title: Stored keys

panels.description: Resident process memory divided by allocated memory. Small datasets can have a high ratio because of fixed process overhead.
panels.title: Memory fragmentation

panels.description: Connected clients and clients waiting in blocking commands. Blocked clients are not automatically an error.
panels.title: Client connections

panels.description: Connections rejected per minute because the server reached its client limit.
panels.title: Rejected connections

panels.description: All processed commands per minute, including monitoring and administrative traffic.
panels.title: Command throughput

panels.description: Command calls per minute, including exporter queries such as INFO and CONFIG.
panels.title: Commands by type

panels.description: Average server execution time per command. Excludes client-pool waits and network latency; idle commands have no value.
panels.title: Command execution time (average)

panels.description: Commands that failed during execution or were rejected before execution. Inspect server logs and client errors for the cause.
panels.title: Command errors

panels.description: Server network traffic in bytes per second. Includes protocol overhead and all clients.
panels.title: Network traffic

panels.description: Time since each server process started. A drop indicates a restart or replacement.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: 1 means the exporter failed its latest collection; 0 means it succeeded. Missing data can indicate an unavailable exporter.
panels.title: Exporter collection errors

options.content: Select one cluster, namespace, and exporter Service. Values are per server (`instance`); the selected Service may expose several nodes. This dashboard measures the whole server. The dedicated Trivy Valkey stores **analysis-cache data**; job/report Redis is separate. Empty rates can mean no activity or missing telemetry. [Exporter documentation](https://github.com/oliver006/redis_exporter)
